description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin named 'keystrokes' that manages custom keystroke handling, including registering keystrokes, blocking default browser behaviors, and attaching keystroke handlers to DOM elements.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.keystrokeHandler
classes.description: A class that manages keystroke events, including mapping keystrokes to commands and blocking default behaviors.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches the keystroke handler to a DOM object to listen for keydown and keypress events.
